kind: Prospective Cosmos3-Nano LIBERO-10 action-policy SFT optimizer qualification (workstream 2, round 11)
lock_scope: Everything below is locked before any comparison-run training output or evaluation is inspected. The single deferred value, fixed_target.success_rate, is computed by the locked rule from the development run only, and is recorded with its own timestamp before any comparison-run evaluation is scored.
source: feat/quantized-optimizers-libero-sft (branched from feat/quantized-optimizers 45a539d4); exact source archive recorded per run in source_identity.json

arms.control_note: Native recipe optimizer (cosmos_framework.utils.generator.fused_adam.FusedAdam, TE multi-tensor, FP32 moments). FSDP2 FP32 shards are its own masters (master_weights derived False).
arms.candidate_note: Shared factory MasterWeightOptimizer + bitsandbytes 0.49.2 AdamW8bit (block-wise uint8 moments, min_8bit_size 4096); FP32 FSDP2 shards aliased as masters, no copy.
arms.paged: paged_adamw_8bit is exercised for training/checkpoint/recovery/memory only; it is not a quality arm.

unchanged_native_recipe.model: nvidia/Cosmos3-Nano 45666784803b3a7ad577e0def405f9afcc3bddb2 converted to DCP; action heads fresh-initialized; net_ema power EMA
unchanged_native_recipe.data: nvidia/LIBERO_LeRobot_v3 e5907374380b8f96511957e6ba5582be52a1e179 libero_10 (379 episodes, 20 FPS), native val_ratio 0.01 split, concat_view, frame_wise_relative rot6d, quantile_rot
unchanged_native_recipe.tokenizers: Wan-AI/Wan2.2-TI2V-5B 921dbaf3f1674a56f47e83fb80a34bac8a8f203e Wan2.2_VAE.pth; Qwen/Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 0c351dd01ed87e9c1b53cbc748cba10e6187ff3b tokenizer files (vocab identical to Cosmos3-Nano)
unchanged_native_recipe.optimizer_hyperparameters: lr 5e-5 (5x for action2llm/llm2action/action_modality_embed), betas (0.9, 0.99), eps 1e-8, weight_decay 0.05, keys_to_select gen+action heads, global-norm clip 1.0 (force_finite)
unchanged_native_recipe.precision: BF16 compute, FP32 FSDP2 shards, FP32 gradient reduction

topology.hardware: one node, 8x A100-SXM4-80GB, configured Slurm routing (polar, polar3, polar4, grizzly)
topology.justification: Native HSDP 2x8 needs 16 GPUs and a two-dimensional mesh the shared eight-bit optimizer does not support. On A100-80GB the native per-rank 128-sample microbatch trains with FusedAdam but fails its first checkpoint save (smoke 38695636, peak 81.2 GiB, NCCL unhandled CUDA error), so the control cannot run it with checkpoints. 64 x grad_accum 4 is the repo-documented lower-memory setting, keeps the global batch, measured 45.6 s/iter (fused) vs 46.1 s/iter (eight-bit), and is identical for both arms.

seed_semantics: trainer.seed and the dataset episode_shuffle_seed are both set to the seed; arms are paired on seed.

development_run.purpose: Learning curve to compute the fixed target by the locked rule; excluded from every comparison statistic.

evaluation.benchmark: LIBERO-10 closed loop, 10 tasks x 50 fixed LIBERO init states = 500 episodes per checkpoint, max 520 control steps
evaluation.episodes: all (task_id, init_state) pairs, task_id 0..9 x init_state 0..49
evaluation.policy: native action_policy_server_libero, EMA weights (server default), unipc 30 steps, guidance 1.0, server seed 0
evaluation.client: native closed_loop_eval.py, agentview+wrist 256, frame_wise_relative rot6d, action_dim 10, full chunk, client seed 0, 8 vectorized envs
evaluation.simulator_runtime: round-ten qualified rlinf-libero 0.1.3 / robosuite 1.4.1 / MuJoCo 3.3.7 environment with its EGL renderer closure; identical for every evaluation
evaluation.held_out_note: LIBERO closed-loop success is the established benchmark; training uses demonstration trajectories, evaluation uses simulator rollouts from the fixed benchmark init states. No additional held-out split exists for libero_10.

primary_metric: closed-loop success rate over the 500 benchmark episodes
secondary_metrics: mean control steps over all episodes (failures included)
training loss and native validation-free iteration time

quality_preservation.criterion: lower 95% bound of (candidate - control) success at iteration 2000 > -0.03
quality_preservation.margin_justification: Prespecified absolute 3-point margin on a 500-episode closed-loop benchmark; WTS NLL/accuracy margins are not reused for robot success.

equal_budget_improvement.criterion: lower 95% bound of (candidate - control) success at iteration 2000 > 0, with protected secondary: candidate mean control steps not above control by more than 5%

fixed_target.rule: P = mean development-run success at iterations 1500, 1750 and 2000; T = floor(0.95 * P, 0.01). If P < 0.20 the protocol is declared uninformative and no time-to-target claim is made.

speed.criterion: lower 95% bound of geometric-mean (control / candidate) time to the fixed target > 1.05
speed.clock: cumulative training-process wall seconds across allocations, from each process start (setup and checkpoint load included) to the completed save of the first evaluated checkpoint whose success >= T; queue time and evaluation excluded (evaluation cost reported separately, identical per checkpoint). A run that never reaches T by iteration 2000 is censored; any censored run fails the speed criterion.
speed.allocation_plan: one allocation per 250 iterations (MAX_ITER = 250k), identical for both arms

statistics.procedure: two-way crossed bootstrap over training seeds and (task, init_state) episode identities, independently resampled; percentile 95% intervals. Time ratios: bootstrap over seeds of the geometric mean.
statistics.no_adaptive_replication: No seeds are added after any interval is observed; failed and censored runs are retained.

memory_accounting: Per-rank optimizer-owned tensor bytes from the opt-in state report after the first step (moments, block scales/metadata, masters; FP32 shard aliases reported separately), plus 30 s sampled per-GPU device memory. Optimizer-state reduction = 1 - candidate/control bytes; requirement >= 60%.

recovery.boundary: published native DCP checkpoint (model, rank-local optimizer payload, scheduler, trainer/RNG)
checks: fresh-process restore of iteration 3 for FusedAdam, adamw_bnb_8bit and paged_adamw_8bit with strict staged validation on every rank (identity, schema, master == restored model shard) before commit
resumed native training to iteration 6 with finite losses and a published checkpoint
exact-continuation equality is established by the two-rank FSDP2 production-checkpointer gate (quantized_optimizer_container_fsdp_test.py)
recovery.native_limitation: The native recipe does not checkpoint the iterable dataloader cursor; a resumed run restarts the data stream, so identical post-resume losses are not expected in the full workflow. This applies equally to both arms and is not changed here.

deployment_variant: Reported, not scored: at the native per-rank 128-sample microbatch the eight-bit arm trains and publishes checkpoints (smoke 38695534, peak 80.1 GiB) where FusedAdam fails its first save. Iteration time is unchanged with microbatch size (45.6-46.5 s), so no time-to-quality benefit is claimed from this feasibility difference.
cost_accounting: Actual terminal allocation intervals x allocated GPUs for every submission including failures, in final_accounting.json.
